projectContext: Sprint 10 (rate-limiting) completed all 10 stories: expanded escalation triggers, wired RateLimitBudget into EscalationManager, unified metrics aggregator, circuit breaker coordination, speed tracker signals, checkpoint persistence, healer integration, and config-driven budget. Sprints 9-10 added 6 new modules to src/downloader/ (impersonation.py, escalation_manager.py, cookie_method_fallback.py, rate_limit_budget.py, rate_limit_metrics.py, types.py) but only escalation_manager and rate_limit_budget/metrics have dedicated test files. This sprint addresses critical testing debt: missing unit tests for new modules, MagicMock anti-patterns causing false positives, skipped test bodies hiding coverage gaps, duplicate test code that should be parametrized, conftest.py lacking centralized download fixtures, and no compilation module tests. Goal: close gaps from sprint 9-10 feature work and improve overall test infrastructure quality.

acceptanceCriteria: Audit test_downloader_core_coverage.py, test_rate_limit_backoff.py, test_tier_rate_limit_isolation.py, test_audio_first_coverage.py for MagicMock auto-attribute usage
Replace direct attribute assignment on MagicMock (e.g., mock._field = value) with explicit mock.configure_mock() or spec-based mocks that validate attribute existence
